closed_children.title: Phase 1: harness root + global providers split
Phase 3: branch naming + step path migration

description:
Migrate the implementation from the v0.2 .agent/-rooted layout to the v0.3 layout pinned by ARCHITECTURE.md commit abfe713 (2026-04-23). Establishes the data-shape foundation that v0.3 tools (bl-683c), v0.5 UI (bl-c0a5), and any further work assume.

The redesign is in-tree as docs already; this epic is the code/template/test follow-through. No new architectural decisions belong here — every shape decision is pinned by the ARCH/PRINCIPLES/TAXONOMY edits in abfe713. If the design seems unclear, push back to those docs and amend them, do not coin in code.

=== Scope of change (full shape diff vs v0.2) ===

1. **Harness root.** Conversation repos move to <harness-root>/conversations/<root-id>/ (default ~/.lernie/, overridable via LERNIE_HOME). Adapters at <harness-root>/adapters/, workflows at .../workflows/, tools at .../tools/, skills at .../skills/, agent profiles at .../agents/. Global providers.yaml at <harness-root>/providers.yaml.

2. **Control files at conv-repo root.** manifest.yaml, workflow.yaml, providers.yaml, version, souls/<role>.md sit at the conv-repo root, OUTSIDE all worktrees. The .agent/ directory disappears entirely.

3. **agents.yaml retired.** Role → model lives in per-repo providers.yaml's roles: section. src/config/agents.rs goes away (or empties).

4. **Provider config splits two ways.**
   - Global <harness-root>/providers.yaml: providers: (endpoint, auth, adapter override) + models: (model_id, capabilities). Rotates live; auth changes propagate.
   - Per-repo providers.yaml: roles: (role → provider name + model id). Frozen at creation.

5. **Sibling worktrees, .git in root/.** Conv repo dir contains: root/ (primary checkout, .git lives here, runs main branch), plus sibling subagent worktrees named by hyphenated descent (<a>-<b>/, <a>-<b>-<c>/). Hierarchy is in the name, not the filesystem.

6. **Branch naming.** Drop ex/<ts>-<id> and inv/<parent>/<id>. Root conversation runs on main; subagent branches named by their full hyphenated descent.

7. **Step on-disk.** steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/{request.json, response.json, tools/}. Drop the exchanges/ and invocations/ directory roots.

8. **Per-branch worktree files.** goal.md, soul.md, summary/<NNN>.md, descriptions/, skills/ — all at worktree root. None of them under .agent/ anymore.

9. **merge=ours discipline.** .gitattributes committed on main at conv-repo creation pins goal.md, soul.md, summary/** to merge=ours so subagent versions don't propagate up on merge-back.

10. **Compactor output relocates.** summary/<NNN>.md replaces .agent/compactions/<NNN>.md. v0.3 compactor remains the deletion-only stub from v0.2; only the path changes.

11. **Skills load into worktree.** Loading a skill = cp -r <harness-root>/skills/<name>/ into <worktree>/skills/<name>/. Descriptions (SKILL.md frontmatter) committed on main at conv creation, inherited by every branch via git.

12. **make install lays down harness root.** ~/.lernie/{adapters,workflows,tools,skills,agents,providers.yaml} skeleton on a fresh install. lernie-provider-anthropic copied to ~/.lernie/adapters/. Other binaries to ~/.local/bin per user direction.

=== Children (claim in this order) ===

Each phase is its own ball. Each carries its own tests/docs/alignment gates per AGENTS.md. Phase boundaries are chosen so that any single phase fits well under the 300-line cap and lands as one bl review.

1. Phase 1 — Harness root + global providers split. LERNIE_HOME plumbing, two-file providers loader, no behavior change to the prompt path yet.
2. Phase 2 — Template skeleton + scaffolding. Replace template/.agent/ with the new layout; update src/template/ embedder; lernie new produces the new shape.
3. Phase 3 — Branch + step migration. dispatch.rs/step.rs/mod.rs/tests. Drop ex/<ts>-<id>, introduce hyphenated branch names, namespace steps by conversation id.
4. Phase 4 — Soul/role machinery + agents.yaml retirement. Roles section in per-repo providers.yaml, soul-by-convention file write at dispatch, remove src/config/agents.rs.
5. Phase 5 — Compactor migration + .gitattributes. summary/<NNN>.md path; .gitattributes written on main at scaffold; verify merge=ours behavior end-to-end with a subagent fixture.
6. Phase 6 — Schema regen + final sweep. Regenerate schemas/*.json against new types. Grep for any lingering .agent/, exchanges/, invocations/, ex/, inv/ strings in src/, crates/, tests/, README.md, AGENTS.md and clean up.
7. Phase 7 — make install harness root scaffold. Makefile target + post-install verification + README/AGENTS update for the new install paths.

Phases 2-5 are tightly coupled (each leaves the build in an inconsistent state until the next lands); the claimer should plan the sequence so the test suite passes at every merge boundary, even if that means folding two phases into one ball where natural.

=== Reconciliation with existing balls ===

- bl-683c (v0.3: tools) — depends on this epic. Tools land into the new layout, not the old one.
- bl-c0a5 (v0.5 UI egui) — depends on this epic. Frontend watch paths assume the new shape.
- bl-e2fb (v0.3 tool contract pin, in_progress) — partially overlaps. Its ARCH §3.3 work is now landed in abfe713 with the new layout already reflected. Whoever resumes bl-e2fb should re-baseline against the new ARCH and trim work that the redesign already covered. Possibly close as duplicate, possibly continue with a reduced scope.
- bl-d15d (Anthropic streaming) — orthogonal, can land before or after.

=== Out of scope ===

- v0.3 tool work itself (binary + schema + skill triple, tool executor, large-output auto-dispatch). That's bl-683c.
- Subagent-dispatch implementation (v0.4). The merge=ours discipline gets a fixture test in Phase 5 but the dispatch tool that creates subagent conversations is v0.4.
- Schema-versioning migration of EXISTING v0.2 conversation repos. Per ARCH §10 old versions must remain readable, but no v0.2 prod corpus exists yet — deferring the migration helper to a v0.3.x cleanup ball if a real corpus appears.

=== Done-when ===

- All seven phase balls closed.
- cargo test + cargo tarpaulin --fail-under 100 green on main.
- A scratch lernie new + lernie prompt cycle produces a conversation repo with the new shape end-to-end.
- The terminal gates (tests, docs, alignment) close on this epic.
title: v0.3 layout migration: implement the new conversation-repo shape
